name_reason: Compliant with data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention: data_fd2_ game-global prefix, domain 'animation', descriptor 'palette_cycle_last_tick' accurately reflects purpose (snapshot of the last palette-cycle update tick). No Ghidra address residue (no _60000 suffix). The 'last_tick' descriptor reflects the data role (a scalar tick-value timestamp). Ghidra primary symbol matches byte-identical.
purpose: Throttle timestamp for the VGA palette-cycle animator: the BIOS midnight tick at which the 16-frame water/lava palette cycle was last advanced.
logic_summary: Single accessor fd2_update_palette_cycle_anim @0x4DFCC. Read @0x4DFD3 as SUB AX,word ptr[0x60000] in the throttle test: the animator advances a frame only when (current_tick - last_tick) >= 2 BIOS ticks (~110ms; CMP AX,0x2 / JC). After painting the 16-color palette window it writes @0x4E028 MOV [0x60000],AX, storing fd2_read_bios_midnight_tick() as the new last-update timestamp.
element_semantics: 16-bit unsigned BIOS midnight-tick snapshot (low word of the 0x40:0x6C tick counter, as returned by fd2_read_bios_midnight_tick); zero-initialized in .object3, no static non-zero seed.
notes: Type ushort (DATA_LEN=2) confirmed by disasm: SUB AX,word ptr[0x60000] read + MOV [0x60000],AX write (both 16-bit). is_const=false: game-side writer at 0x4E028. Ghidra plate at 0x60000 was NULL before this run; created a concise plate via run_script_inline PLATE_COMMENT summarizing the conclusion (consistent with the src comment block at palette.c lines 12-26, which is already precise and was left unchanged -> comment_verdict=keep, no src diff). Reader/writer counts: 1 read xref, 1 write xref, both in fd2_update_palette_cycle_anim.
